Right-Hand Thumb Rule: why does a compass needle turn near a current-carrying wire? Class 10 Physics, Magnetic Effects of Electric Current.

• An electric current makes a magnetic field (Oersted, 1820)
• Around a straight wire the field lines are concentric circles, stronger near the wire
• Right hand: thumb along the current, the curled fingers give the field's direction
• Reverse the current and the field reverses too
